body:
Sept 26 (Reuters) - Private equity group Apax is nearing a deal to buy Warburg Pincus out of their joint investment in Dutch telecoms group Odido, the Financial Times reported on Saturday.

Deal Valuation and Financial Details

The deal would value Odido at about €6.5 billion ($7.4 billion), the FT reported, citing people familiar with the matter

Background on Odido's IPO Plans

In the same week, the Dutch telecoms group suffered a cyberattack that exposed personal information from more than 6 million accounts

Acquisition Interest from Other Suitors

The owners have since received approaches for the business from suitors including Saudi Arabian state-backed telecoms group STC, the FT reported

Apax, Odido and Warburg Pincus declined to comment. STC did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment outside regular business hours

History of Ownership and Previous Transactions

Apax and Warburg Pincus acquired the business under its previous name T-Mobile Netherlands in 2021 at an enterprise value of €5.1 billion

(Reporting by Devika Nair in Bengaluru; Editing by Christopher Cushing, Kirsten Donovan and Alexander Smith)

The proposed deal would value Odido at about €6.5 billion ($7.4 billion), up from its 2021 acquisition value of €5.1 billion (marketscreener.com)

Odido postponed its IPO in Amsterdam in February 2026 following a tepid investor response and heightened market volatility; the same week it also suffered a cyberattack exposing personal data of over 6 million accounts (marketscreener.com)

Since then, suitors including Saudi state-backed STC have approached, but Apax is now nearing a deal to take full control; Odido, Apax and Warburg Pincus declined comment (marketscreener.com)

Frequently Asked Questions

The deal would reportedly value Dutch telecoms group Odido at about €6.5 billion.

Odido postponed its IPO due to a muted investor response and concerns about volatility in global equity markets.

Odido is currently owned by Apax and Warburg Pincus.

Odido suffered a cyberattack exposing personal information from more than 6 million accounts.

Saudi Arabian state-backed telecoms group STC reportedly showed interest in acquiring Odido.
